exceptions.reason: Vite's CSS transformer, used unmodified at build time only. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: it binds changes to its own files, not the code that uses it.
Platform binaries of lightningcss 1.33.0; same reason. Pinned to the version, so an update is judged again.

Its package.json has no license field; the LICENSE file in the published tarball is Apache-2.0 (checked 2026-11-02). A dependency of @workflow/cli, which the workflow package (ADR-0009) always installs; not bundled into any deployed function.
